headline: Approved $43,479,897.00 Harvey Construction contract and related DPW garage project contracts, amendments, and invoices.
summary: Members received a progress update on the DPW garage and maintenance project. Site mobilization is set to begin in November, and demolition of buildings on site is to start within the next few weeks. Members approved three invoices and four contracts or amendments for the project, with Alderman Johnson opposed to each.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 27, 2026 meeting.
Approved three DPW garage project invoices from LeftField, HKT Architects, and Harvey/Bode, with Alderman Johnson opposed.
Approved LeftField and HKT amendments, UTS of MA site testing contract, and Harvey Construction contract and GMP for $43,479,897.00, with Alderman Johnson opposed.

GARAGE & MAINTENANCE PROJECT 
NASHUA 
DIVISION OF 
PUBLIC WORKS
COMPLETED TASKS 
• The Division of Public Works, Leftfield, 
Harvey Construction and HKT attended a 
Kick-Off Meeting on 10/21/2026 to review 
the processes and expectations throughout 
the Construction of the DPW Garage and 
Maintenance Project. 
• Harvey is continuing descoping with their 
subcontractors and committed to the Final 
GMP to which will be brought to the Joint 
Committee on 10/22/26. 
• A Third Party Construction Testing Agency 
will be brought in to assure the City of 
Nashua will receive a functional, solid 
building per the design. 
• A Project Website is currently live and will 
be updated as project progress continues. 
Any information on the site will be reviewed 
by the DPW and their Project Team. 
• A Logistics plan has been received from 
Harvey and reviewed by the Project Team 
prior to start of Construction. 
GARAGE & MAINTENANCE PROJECT
NEXT STEPS 
• Weekly Meetings will continue with the 
entire Project Team, to review schedule, 
budget, RFIs, Submittals and progress on 
site. 
• Site Mobilization is set to begin in 
November including installation of 
temporary fencing and Harvey’s 
construction office trailer. 
• The DPW has taken steps to start the 
demolition of varies buildings on site in 
preparation for Construction. The 
Demolition will begin within the next few 
weeks. 
• A Commissioning Agent will be hired to 
review and test the building envelope, 
HVAC systems, controls and lighting 
throughout the building and site. 
GARAGE & MAINTENANCE PROJECT
